responsibility: This file implements SPARC hooks for the D front end. It registers D builtin version identifiers that describe SPARC vs SPARC64, V8Plus availability, and hard- vs soft-float operation, and it provides TARGET_D_REGISTER_CPU_TARGET_INFO support for __traits(getTargetInfo, "floatAbi"), bridging GCC’s SPARC target state into D-language conditional compilation and target-info queries.
same_name_distinction: Implements the SPARC-specific D frontend hook bodies, unlike sparc-d.h which only declares and wires those hooks. Within the same-name group, this is the executable source that computes D version identifiers and the "floatAbi" target-info result from TARGET_64BIT, TARGET_V8PLUS, and TARGET_FPU.
